1. STATE AT REST - whole block 22 C, P_sys ~1.8 bar abs, no flow
Everything at 22 C, no flow. All solution-side liquid is one communicating column at the rest level (pool, outlet bore, HX tube + channel,
feed, boiler, riser, weak up- and down-legs, trap drain leg + both legs of the vapour-line U up to 86). Separator, rectifier, cascade,
the rest of the vapour line and the precooler channels: gas.
PFP: evaporator pool and condenser sump communicate through the PFP tube (its dip to Z47 is liquid-full, harmless). Evaporator PFP surface
sits above the condenser interface by 1.30 x (solution layer) because 1 mm of solution weighs 0.56 mm of PFP. Sparger stub fills with PFP.
The vapour line climbs to Z95.5 before the dip tube, so the solution standing in the U at rest (and ~90 during the first seconds of
light-off) cannot reach the evaporator; the drain empties the U as soon as the riser pumps. Well tube annulus is at P_sys.
Gas everywhere is the same equilibrium mixture: NH3 ~1.0 bar (over 30 % solution) + PFP ~0.8 bar + H2O 0.02 bar -> ~1.8 bar abs.
All solution is the 30 wt% charge (drawn as strong); it splits into strong/weak only once the boiler runs.
2. HYDROSTATIC CHECK (computed by make_svg.py from inventory + geometry; rho_sol 920, rho_PFP 1630 kg/m3)
Charges: solution 23.2 mL (30 wt% NH3), PFP 8.6 mL (14.0 g; well displaces 3.3 mL). Rest level set to 86.0 by the solution charge.
REST: solution level 86.0 everywhere. PFP: condenser interface 77.7, evaporator surface 82.4 (pool depth 18.4, well immersed 15.9).
RUN: riser 65 % void + boiler 20 % void free ~3.0 mL; weak leg fills to crest; cascade holds ~0.3 mL -> pool level 90.6.
PFP interface 76.4 (outlet port bore bottom 79.75 stays 3.4 mm above it), evaporator PFP surface 83.6, bubbling depth 12.1 mm.
P_sep - P_sys = 12.1 mm PFP x 1630 g + ~40 Pa friction = 233 Pa = 25.8 mm solution -> trap level 84.2; seal margin to Z30 = 54 mm.
P_boiler(feed) - P_sys = 233 + 2-phase riser 253 + boiler column 144 = 630 Pa. Head available from pool = 764 Pa.
Surplus 134 Pa is taken by the dia 1.2 restriction (+ tube friction ~60 Pa) -> circulation ~0.3 mL/s; outlet bore & HX stay flooded.
Trap drain (junction at boiler pressure, top at vapour-line pressure): level = 6 + (630 - 233) Pa / (rho g) = 50.0 < trap Z60 by 10 mm,
so condensate dripping into the U runs down the leg. Joined UPSTREAM of the restriction it would stand at 65 and flood the vapour line.
Sensitivities: 1 mL solution = 2.4 mm of pool level; 1 mL PFP = 3.0 mm of evaporator depth. Fill by watching the levels through the block.
Startup: riser full of liquid to 86; first bubbles lift slugs; separator pressure pushes trap leg down 25 mm; vapour then bubbles at sparger.
3. FLOW CONTROL - what sets each flow
Vapour: heat input. Solution circulation: dia 1.2 x 8 restriction + HX tube friction against the surplus head (only deliberate restriction).
Weak return: gravity from crest, self-metering; trap seal, not a restriction. PFP: hydrostatic self-levelling. Skimmer: barometric leg.
Sparger holes: 4 x dia 1.0 -> ~5 Pa. Water trap: barometric leg, no control. The weak-trap, pool and drain-leg levels are the visible health indicators.
Restriction sizing: at 0.3 mL/s the dia 1.2 x 8 capillary takes ~75 Pa (laminar + entry) and the 224 mm ID 2.5 tube + bores ~70 Pa = the 134 Pa surplus.
Mass balance needs 0.13-0.38 mL/s (13 % to 5 % swing), so 0.3 is right; the pool level is the feedback (rises until the feed matches the pump).
Gas-side friction: NH3 12 mL/s in dia 3.5 bores ~35 Pa/m (laminar); exit gas 15 mL/s (M 62, rho 6.7) in dia 3.5 ~100 Pa/m -> ~40 Pa total, as assumed.
4. OPERATING POINT & CAPACITY (from thermo_check.py)
P_sys ~2.5 bar: boiler 65 C -> weak 24 wt%; Cu 35 C: PFP sat 1.23 bar -> NH3 partial 1.27 bar -> strong 29 % (co-current) to 37 % (counterflow limit).
Evaporator 5 C: PFP partial 0.42 bar -> 5 mol NH3 per mol PFP. Sensible loads: PFP liquid 35->5 C = 9 kJ/mol, NH3 1 kJ/mol. With both precoolers
(~55 % on PFP, ~90 % on NH3) net ~20 kJ/mol PFP. Boiler ~3.5 kJ/g NH3. 30 W (candle) -> ~2.3 W cooling; 80 W (burner) -> ~5.5 W.
Cold-zone leak ~1.5-2 W (larger cavity, well tube conducts ~0.05 W/K from the flange). Keep Cu condenser plate <= 35 C (heatsink <= 0.2 K/W).
Hot zone: separator must stay at boiler temperature - every 10 C of subcooling there lets the weak solution re-absorb ~5 wt% NH3 and halves the swing.
Rest ~1.8 bar, running 2.3-2.8 bar. Design block for 4 bar abs, hydrotest 6 bar: outer walls >= 6 mm on chamber faces (4 mm on evaporator front/back
and right face - 24 x 34 mm spans, ~5 MPa bending at 1.5 bar gauge); internal walls 1-1.5 mm (no dP).
5. CONSTRUCTION DETAILS
Both Cu plates on the BACK face. Boiler cavity 22x22 (Z4-26) is open to Y30; plate 34x58 covers it, extends 26 mm below the block as a tab
into the flame (fins on the tab, fins into the cavity). Block bottom face is solid; keep the flame off the resin with a shield under the block.
Cold well: SS tube OD 16 / ID 14, ~90 mm, closed round bottom at Z66.5, flange 28 mm with O-ring face seal on the top face, 4x M3 into brass inserts;
bore Z98-150 is dia 16.2 (annulus at P_sys). A 13 x 100 mm test tube with ~3 mL sample sits fully inside the PFP-immersed length.
Evaporator cavity 24 x 22 (Y4-26) x 34: well at x155.5 leaves 5.5 mm on the left for the sparger (1.45 mm each side), 2.5 right, 3 front/back.
Tube-in-channel HX (x3): inner tube ID 2.5 / OD 4.1, 3 radial ribs 0.8 mm per pass; solution HX 6x6 channel under the pool (Z30-58.5);
NH3 precooler 7x7 channel x116-134 (Z103-137); PFP precooler 7x34 vertical channel x115.5-122.5 (Z40-74), tube enters left wall, leaves right wall.
Water trap: vapour tube ID 2.5 drops from the precooler floor (x127) to Z60, crosses 6.5 mm, rises at x133.5 to Z95.5; drain dia 2.5 leaves the U bottom.
Bore crossings at different Y: strong outlet bore x105.5 at Y23 (jogs to Y15 at HX) clears PFP line Y15 at Z72; exit-gas down-bore x137 at Y24
clears the PFP up-bore x139.5 (Y15) and the vapour inlet Z95.5 (Y10); trap drain x131 at Y8 clears the PFP horizontal Z47 and gas Z41.5.
Ports P1-P3: dia 3 through front wall, M5 brass insert + O-ring plug. P1 purges non-condensables at the absorber dead end.
Cold zone: front face bare for viewing; foam on back/top/right faces + slots. Hot zone: foam in slots, on back face around the boiler plate, and under the block.
Inserts: M3 heat-set OD 4.0 x 5.7 from the back face; centres 3.5 mm outside cavity openings; >= 1.5 mm resin to every slot / bore (audited by check_clearances.py).
Y-jogs (short bores along Y, same dia): strong down-bore x105.5 at Z78 (Y15->23) and Z62 (Y23->15); exit gas at x126/Z41.5 (Y24->15); trap drain at x131/Z6 (Y8->15).
Tube-in-channel print: ribs every <= 15 mm (3 per pass); print with channels horizontal; flush uncured resin through the channel ports.
Post-print: ream the dia 1.2 restriction and the sparger holes (SLA closes small holes); hydrotest 6 bar with water before charging.
FILL: evacuate via P1. PFP first via P2, by mass (14.0 g). Then 30 wt% NH3 solution via P3 until the pool reads Z86 +/- 1 (block cold). Rest pressure ~1.8 bar.
